crossRefs.note: For the iniquity of the daughter of my people is greater than the sin of Sodom, which was overthrown as in a moment. No…
Those who are killed with the sword are better than those who are killed with hunger; For these pine away, stricken…
He has confirmed his words, which he spoke against us, and against our judges who judged us, by bringing on us a great…
“I have only chosen you of all the families of the earth. Therefore I will punish you for all of your sins.”
for then there will be great suffering, such as has not been from the beginning of the world until now, no, nor ever…

translations.web: I will do in you that which I have not done, and which I will not do anything like it any more, because of all your abominations.
translations.bsb: Because of all your abominations, I will do to you what I have never done before and will never do again.
translations.kjv: And I will do in thee that which I have not done, and whereunto I will not do any more the like, because of all thine abominations.
translations.asv: And I will do in thee that which I have not done, and whereunto I will not do any more the like, because of all thine abominations.
